<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.194, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈267.187 Da. A plausible molecular formula that matches this exact mass within a few millidaltons is C₁₂H₂₇O₆. This formula also fits the observed isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 20 % and M+2 ≈ 2 %).</thought>
<final_answer>C12H27O6</final_answer>
